name: Narin Wirachaisuk
bio: Narin started the Studio to work on small buildings and the rooms inside them. She still draws the first section of every new house herself.

name: Ploy Anuwatkul
bio: Ploy sets the direction of the Studio's interiors and looks after how a project reads as a whole. She has strong opinions about door handles.

name: Krit Sombatthavee
bio: Krit leads the Studio's new-build design work, starting from the roof and the path of the sun. He keeps a notebook of eaves he has walked under.

name: Mali Prasertwong
bio: Mali specifies the materials the Studio uses and tests how they age in Bangkok's damp. Her desk is usually covered in plaster samples.

name: Thanawat Ruangchai
bio: Thanawat develops site plans and drawings for the Studio's houses. He works closely with the engineers each client appoints.

name: Sirin Techamanee
bio: Sirin designs cafes, counters and shops, and starts each one by watching how people queue. She measures every stool by sitting on it.

name: Arun Kittiwong
bio: Arun leads the Studio's workplace projects, with a particular interest in light and sound. He believes most meetings need a smaller room.

name: Nok Charoensri
bio: Nok keeps drawings moving between the Studio, the engineers and the contractors a client appoints. She knows where every revision is.
